title: SemEval 2026 — Narrative Similarity Task (ACL)
shortDescription: Transformer-based models for deep semantic alignment and cross-text narrative understanding; secured 3rd rank in shared task.
description: Secured 3rd rank in the SemEval 2026 Narrative Similarity shared task organized under ACL by designing transformer-based models for deep semantic alignment and cross-text narrative understanding.
problem: Evaluating semantic similarity across complex narrative structures requires understanding deep inter-textual relationships, temporal progressions, and thematic context rather than surface-level lexical overlap.
approach: Engineered a hybrid system combining embedding-based similarity representations and structured LLM prompting with complementarity-driven ensembling for robust cross-text alignment.
architecture: Text Input Pairs → Transformer Embedding Extraction → Dense Semantic Similarity Mapping + Structured LLM Prompting → Complementarity Ensemble → Narrative Similarity Score
resultOrAchievement: Secured 3rd rank globally in the SemEval 2026 Narrative Similarity shared task (ACL).

title: Grounded Citation RAG System
shortDescription: Advanced RAG framework with grounded citations enabling LLM responses to provide verifiable passage-level attribution.
description: Designed and implemented an advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework with grounded citations, enabling LLM responses to provide precise source attribution at the passage level. Developed a citation-grounding pipeline that links generated answers directly to supporting documents, improving explainability, traceability, and reducing hallucinations in AI-generated responses.
problem: Large language models frequently hallucinate or generate plausible assertions without transparent provenance, creating critical trust bottlenecks in domain-specific workflows.
approach: Architected a dual retrieval and citation-grounding framework that maps generated claims back to retrieved passage segments with explainable attribution traces.
architecture: Query Processing → Vector Retrieval → Context Assembly → LLM Generation → Passage Citation Grounding → Traceable Output with Source Verification
resultOrAchievement: Delivered explainable, traceable generative responses with passage-level source attribution.

title: Hospital Document OCR System — Swami Rama Himalayan Hospital
shortDescription: Robust OCR pipeline for noisy medical records, varied clinical layouts, and doctor handwriting.
description: Designed and deployed a robust OCR pipeline for hospital documents, addressing challenges such as noisy scans, varied document layouts, and doctor handwriting. Integrated preprocessing, layout analysis, and post-processing techniques to enable structured data extraction from medical records.
problem: Real-world hospital documents suffer from scan noise, degraded print, non-standard tabular forms, and handwritten doctor notes, which impede automated electronic health record ingestion.
approach: Integrated image denoising, adaptive binarization, document layout analysis, and post-processing normalizers to reliably extract key clinical entities into structured formats.
architecture: Noisy Hospital Scan → Adaptive Preprocessing & Denoising → Document Layout Segmentation → Handwriting & Print OCR → Domain Post-Processing → Structured Medical Data
resultOrAchievement: Deployed at Swami Rama Himalayan Hospital for structured electronic extraction from medical records.

title: OCR Pipeline for Historical Books
shortDescription: End-to-end OCR pipeline for degraded historical book scans using denoising and script-aware text normalization.
description: Designed an end-to-end OCR pipeline for degraded historical book scans, applying advanced preprocessing, denoising, and text normalization techniques to convert low-quality images into structured, readable, and editable text.
problem: Archival historical texts contain paper bleed-through, faded typography, warping, and archaic orthography, leading standard commercial OCR systems to fail.
approach: Built custom filtering pipelines for background artifact removal, non-linear distortion correction, and character normalization tailored to archival prints.
architecture: Archival Book Scan → Dewarping & Artifact Filtering → Denoising & Contrast Enhancement → OCR Engine → Script-Aware Text Normalization → Structured Digital Corpus
resultOrAchievement: Converted severely degraded archival scans into clean, searchable, structured text.

title: Knowledge Graph for Historical Books
shortDescription: Semantic knowledge graph linking entities and events across Sanskrit and Hindi texts for intelligent search and lineage tracking.
description: Developed a semantic knowledge graph linking entities and events across Sanskrit/Hindi texts for intelligent search and lineage tracking.
problem: Historical literature spans complex genealogies, interconnected events, and multi-century timelines that are difficult to query or cross-reference through linear reading.
approach: Extracted named entities, familial relationships, and chronological events from multilingual source texts to construct a connected graph database with semantic query capabilities.
architecture: Sanskrit/Hindi Text Corpus → Entity & Relation Extraction → Ontological Alignment → Graph Construction → Lineage & Temporal Traversal Query Interface
resultOrAchievement: Enabled multi-hop semantic querying and genealogical lineage tracking across historical corpora.

title: Mass Attendance System
shortDescription: Full face-recognition pipeline using ResNet, GhostFaceNet, and FaceNet with video data collection and embedding optimization.
description: Designed a full face-recognition pipeline using ResNet, GhostFaceNet, and FaceNet. Implemented video-based data collection, embedding optimization, L2 normalization, and 2D/3D visualizations.
problem: Handling automated identity verification in crowded environments requires lightweight, high-throughput facial feature extractors that remain robust against varying lighting and angles.
approach: Evaluated multiple backbone architectures (ResNet, GhostFaceNet, FaceNet), optimized embedding spaces using L2 normalization, and built intuitive 2D/3D embedding space inspection tooling.
architecture: Video Stream Frame Grabber → Face Detection & Alignment → Backbone Feature Extractor → L2 Normalized Embeddings → Vector Distance Matching → Attendance Log
resultOrAchievement: Implemented automated real-world attendance processing with 2D/3D embedding space visualization.

title: Monocular Depth Estimation System
shortDescription: Monocular depth estimation model for distance-aware geometric analysis in real-time visual scenes.
description: Built a monocular depth estimation model for distance-aware analysis in real-time scenes.
problem: Estimating scene depth from single standard RGB camera sensors without dedicated stereo rigs or LiDAR sensors.
approach: Trained and deployed deep convolutional/transformer estimation networks to predict dense pixel-level continuous depth maps for spatial reasoning.
architecture: RGB Camera Feed → Deep Feature Encoder → Multi-Scale Depth Decoder → Continuous Depth Map Projection → Spatial Distance Analysis
resultOrAchievement: Delivered real-time pixel-wise depth prediction from standard monocular camera streams.

title: COLING 2025 — AI-Generated Content Detection (ACL)
shortDescription: Fine-tuned multilingual transformer models (RoBERTa, XLM-R) for classifying human vs AI-generated text; peer-reviewed publication.
description: Fine-tuned multilingual transformer models (RoBERTa, XLM-R) for classifying human vs AI-generated text; contributed to a peer-reviewed publication at COLING 2025.
problem: Distinguishing synthetic machine-generated text from human authorship across multiple languages with high inference speed and resistance to stylistic perturbations.
approach: Applied cross-lingual pre-trained transformer architectures, optimized fine-tuning hyperparameters, and conducted rigorous multi-language validation.
architecture: Multilingual Text → Tokenization (SentencePiece) → RoBERTa / XLM-R Encoders → Classification Head → Human vs Machine Probability Score
resultOrAchievement: Published research at COLING 2025; achieved enhanced F1 score via systematic training parameter optimization.

title: Journey Tracker for Historical Books
shortDescription: Semantic tracing system to track characters and events across large historical texts using NLP and dense embeddings.
description: Created a semantic tracing system to track characters and events across large historical books using NLP and embeddings.
problem: Tracking spatial-temporal movements and evolving narrative arcs of individuals across extensive literary works with archaic or non-standard naming conventions.
approach: Combined named entity disambiguation, semantic co-reference resolution, and vector embedding matching to assemble cohesive chronological journey paths.
architecture: Book Chapters → NLP Text Extraction → Entity Coreference & Disambiguation → Geospatial/Temporal Anchoring → Interactive Journey Timeline
resultOrAchievement: Constructed end-to-end spatial-temporal tracking of character journeys across multi-chapter literary works.

title: Mathematical Formula Extraction — Innopat
shortDescription: Integrated NOUGAT OCR and post-processing steps to extract mathematical expressions and convert them to LaTeX and MathML.
description: Integrated NOUGAT OCR and post-processing steps to extract mathematical expressions and convert them to LaTeX/MathML.
problem: Scientific and patent literature contains dense two-dimensional mathematical notation that traditional OCR parses as garbled strings.
approach: Integrated neural vision-language model NOUGAT with specialized syntax validation post-processors to convert visual equations into compilable LaTeX and standard MathML.
architecture: Formula Image Crop → Visual Encoder → Autoregressive Equation Decoder (NOUGAT) → Syntax Validation & Normalization → Compilable LaTeX / MathML
resultOrAchievement: Automated high-fidelity extraction of complex scientific formulas into machine-readable LaTeX/MathML.

title: Multilingual OCR (Sanskrit, Hindi, English)
shortDescription: Multilingual OCR for Sanskrit, Hindi, and English using Surya OCR with specialized preprocessing and script-aware normalization.
description: Built OCR for Sanskrit/Hindi/English using Surya OCR with specialized preprocessing, noise removal, and script-aware normalization.
problem: Mixed-script documents featuring Devanagari conjuncts (samyuktakshar) alongside Roman characters require script-level disambiguation to prevent character corruption.
approach: Developed preprocessing noise-removal filters paired with Surya OCR layout and text recognition models, followed by Devanagari Unicode script-aware normalizers.
architecture: Multilingual Document → Noise Filter & Contrast Balance → Line/Word Detection → Script-Aware Recognition (Surya OCR) → Unicode Post-Normalization
resultOrAchievement: Achieved accurate optical character recognition across mixed Sanskrit, Hindi, and English texts.

title: Real-Time Wildfire Detection
shortDescription: Implemented YOLOv8-based real-time wildfire detector with a responsive Streamlit monitoring dashboard.
description: Implemented YOLOv8-based real-time wildfire detector with a Streamlit dashboard.
problem: Early detection of smoke and flame fronts is crucial for environmental safety and rapid emergency dispatch in vulnerable forested regions.
approach: Fine-tuned YOLOv8 object detection on aerial and terrestrial wildfire datasets, coupled with a lightweight real-time alert and visualization dashboard built in Streamlit.
architecture: Live Camera/Video Feed → YOLOv8 Inference Engine → Flame & Smoke Bounding Box Prediction → Confidence Thresholding → Streamlit Dashboard Alert
resultOrAchievement: Deployed real-time wildfire monitoring with instant detection overlays on Streamlit dashboard.
